subject: Short-window capacity laddering & overrun repricing
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@launchpad.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — short window capacity & pricing for Aug 30 launch

Hey Dylan,

We're going live with a targeted feature on Aug 30 and expect a concentrated traffic spike for 48 hours. Can Redwood temporarily lift our concurrency and quota for that window? Two asks: 1) a short-window uplift (48h) and 2) a softened overrun rate for that uplift — procurement wants a predictable cap and a discounted burn rate compared to our standard overrun.

Numbers: we estimate ~120M tokens peak over the 48h (on top of committed). We'd like the uplift to cover up to 150M tokens with a maximum invoice exposure not to exceed $12,000 for the surge.

Can you tell me what you can offer quickly? Also cc'ing Clara (ops) and finance (finance@launchpad.ai) — Procurement will need a simple SOW and an invoice path to approve by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Product, LaunchPad AI

Attachments: none
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@launchpad.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-23T13:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short window capacity & pricing for Aug 30 launch

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up. We can support a temporary uplift for a 48-hour window with a pricing plan that maps to what procurement needs:

Proposal (summary):
- Uplift window: 2028-08-30T00:00Z to 2028-09-01T00:00Z (48h)
- Reserved uplift: additional capacity to absorb up to 150M tokens over committed usage
- Blended overrun rate during uplift: $0.036/token (discounted from your standard $0.055 overrun rate)
- Safety cap: we can hard-cap billable overrun to $12,000 if you provide a PO that references deal LP-2028-08-30-U1 and pre-authorizes the cap (we'll invoice only actual usage up to the cap)
- Rollback: usage throttles back automatically at window end; no change to contract beyond the PO & SOW

Next steps:
1) If acceptable, sign the attached short SOW (LaunchPad_temp_uplift_SOW.pdf).
2) Send PO to billing@redwood.com referencing LP-2028-08-30-U1 and the $12k cap.
3) We'll issue a provisional invoice and a DocuSign for the SOW; legal has pre-approved this as a temporary commercial amendment.

I've looped in Monica (CS) to coordinate monitoring during the window. Let us know if you need a lower per-token rate in exchange for a small prepayment — we can structure that too.

— Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: LaunchPad_temp_uplift_SOW.pdf
From: Clara Liu <clara.liu@launchpad.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Meyers <jordan@launchpad.ai>, finance@launchpad.ai
Date: 2028-08-24T08:17:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short window capacity & pricing for Aug 30 launch

Dylan — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying items from procurement & finance:

- The $12k cap is acceptable if the blended rate and token estimate are guaranteed for the uplift window; can you include language that the blended rate applies only to uplift tokens consumed within the 48h window?
- We need visibility into usage thresholds so we can trigger an internal alert at 75% of the uplift allocation. Can Monica or someone from CS provide a monitoring hook or Slack alert?
- If we move to a 50% prepayment of the $12k cap, can you reduce the blended rate further to $0.030/token for the uplift tranche? Procurement prefers a small prepay to keep invoice exposure down.

If you can confirm the monitoring plan and the prepay discount, we'll route the PO and payment today.

Thanks,
Clara
Launch Operations, LaunchPad AI
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Clara Liu <clara.liu@launchpad.ai>, Jordan Meyers <jordan@launchpad.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-25T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short window capacity & pricing for Aug 30 launch

Clara/Jordan — hey, Monica from CS here. Quick answers and confirmation:

- Rate window: confirmed — the discounted blended rate applies only to tokens consumed against the uplift tranche during the 48h window (we will mark usage accordingly in billing).
- Monitoring: we will push a Slack alert to your #launchpad-ops channel at 75% and 90% of uplift consumption; I'll create a temporary read-only dashboard link for the window and share it in the DocuSign payload.
- Prepayment option: yes — if LaunchPad prepays $6,000 (50% of the cap), we will apply the lower uplift rate of $0.030/token for the uplift tranche. The prepayment will be applied against the final uplift invoice; any unused prepay will be credited back.

Attached: provisional invoice and SOW for signature and PO routing. Ben (finance ops) is on copy to approve the invoicing path. Once you return the signed SOW and PO, we will enable the uplift and schedule the monitoring hooks 24 hours before the window.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional_invoice_LP-20280823.pdf, LaunchPad_temp_uplift_SOW.pdf
